summary: Sameer Prasla, 42, of Austin, Texas, drowned after a commercial raft carrying a Boy Scouts group flipped near Spike Buck Rapids; he was pulled from the river, CPR was given, Flight for Life landed, and he was pronounced dead at the scene
location: Arkansas River near Spike Buck Rapids, ~15-17 miles west of Canon City
notes: Run 993 Chieftain chunk: source is an American Whitewater accident page quoting the Pueblo Chieftain and the Canon City Daily Record (no Chieftain original located); responders also included Tallahassee Fire Protection District, American Medical Response, and Colorado Parks and Wildlife.
